title: Assertion: FIFO Flags and Count
constraints: An 8-entry FIFO. Rule 1: `full == (count == 8)` and `empty == (count == 0)` at every edge.
Rule 2: an accepted push (`push && !full`) without an accepted pop increments `count` by one on the next edge. An accepted pop without an accepted push decrements it. Otherwise `count` holds.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Flag consistency is an invariant (no implication needed).
Compute `do_push = push && !full` and `do_pop = pop && !empty` as `let` or wires, then write the three count cases with `|=>` and `$past(count)`.

examples.title: ok
examples.input: pushes then pops with consistent flags
